note: Every external interface is environment-selected. Switching provider, or turning live proposals on, is an environment edit rather than a code change — and a half-configured environment raises instead of quietly behaving like a fixture run.

seams.detail: Scripted stand-ins today; a live model plugs into the same Callable.
seams.name: Proposal adapter

seams.detail: Read by the provider SDK from the environment; never written in code.
seams.name: Provider credentials

seams.detail: Who may record a decision. The fixtures use one reviewer.
seams.name: Reviewer allowlist

seams.detail: The approved contract, rate card and spending limit a submission is checked against.
seams.name: Contract registry

seams.detail: Collection requests and reminders are composed to an in-memory outbox; no mail leaves.
seams.name: Supplier correspondence

seams.detail: Frozen event records held in memory. Durable retention is an integration responsibility.
seams.name: Evidence archive

seams.detail: Per-call input and output tokens. Zero under the scripted adapter, because nothing is called.
seams.name: Token accounting

seams.detail: Not a seam. This workflow reaches a validation decision and stops; it never instructs a payment.
seams.name: Payment
